coverage.statement: All135 local candidate contests and all373 printed named choices in the countywide comprehensive sample ballot are included. Three shared offices reuse existing IDs: WrightwoodCSD from LosAngeles and two water-district/agency offices from Riverside. Federal/statewide/legislative and already-held judicial retentions remain unchanged. Two later qualified write-ins are held as separate status-labeled records. This is a countywide comprehensive sample, not one precinct style.
coverage.remaining: Reader representation for separate qualified write-in records and missing exact division memberships remain with River/CX-LOCAL geography work.

readerBoundaryDependency: School/college governing areas, county education areas, city council districts/wards and special-district divisions keep their exact printed electorate. No district membership is widened to its entire county, school district or city.
operation: Main performs focused existing API validation and commits; River installs through the established data path and checks readers. No production writes or git operations by this worker.
nextOwner: Main: focused validation and commit. River: existing data install and live checks; geography/write-in representation dependencies remain explicit.
